sloka: प्रगृह्य परम क्रुद्धाः समुत्पत्य च राक्षसाः ।अब्रुवन् रावणम् सर्वे प्रदीप्ता इव तेजसा ॥६-९-५॥।।
transliteration: pragṛhya parama kruddhāḥ samutpatya ca rākṣasāḥ ।abruvan rāvaṇam sarve pradīptā iva tejasā ॥6-9-5॥।।

translations.english: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
